dai_shuren.name: Dai Shuren
dai_shuren.title: Chief custodian of the mountain archive
dai_shuren.appearance: Silver hair tightly pinned; weathered narrow face, ink-dark indexfinger, patched indigo robe, plainbronze readingglass chain.
dai_shuren.interest: Preserves originals and entrusted privacy; fears false certification and loss of custody.

luo_zhimo.name: Luo Zhimo
luo_zhimo.title: Steward of the public reading tables
luo_zhimo.appearance: Short black hair with grey temples, broad tired face, brown layeredrobe, woodenbookplate in pocket.
luo_zhimo.interest: Makes records usable before poverty/outside deadlines make preserved rights inaccessible.

tan_ke.name: Tan Ke
tan_ke.title: Archive preservation technician
tan_ke.appearance: Crop of dark hair, small scar at chin, rolled ochre sleeves, apron mended with unequalthread.
tan_ke.interest: Practical conservation and honest safety limits; declines miracles that conceal structural damage.

he_xi.name: He Xi
he_xi.title: Mountain courier and inheritance petitioner
he_xi.appearance: Slender, wind-burned cheeks, long plait tucked in collar, fadedteal coat, broad carryingstraps.
he_xi.interest: A paid livelihood and fair hearing of disputed familyclaim, without becoming a permanent unpaid witness.

sun_nian.name: Sun Nian
sun_nian.title: Retired school copyist and oral witness
sun_nian.appearance: White hair in soft knot, clouded left eye, plum-colouredpadded robe, woodenwalkingstick wornsmooth.
sun_nian.interest: Accurate bounded testimony, useful publicschool arrangements and authority over her private recollections.
